description: Stop forwarding a subdomain. The name itself stays registered on the account; only the redirect is removed.

api_key.description: Your AgentDomains API key (adom_…). Only needed when this MCP connection has no `Authorization: Bearer` header, for example right after calling signup.

domain.description: Which domain to act under: 'makes.fyi' (the default) or 'agentdomains.co'. The same label can exist under each, so pass this whenever you are not using the default.

label.description: The subdomain label, without the domain suffix (e.g. 'myapp' for myapp.makes.fyi).

name: remove_forward
title: Remove a forward
